QF.id: AIFM CIII Modern Portfolio Theory and Capital Market Theory_13

question.text: Satpura Market-Neutral Fund delivered 14% gross return over the year, risk-free rate was 6%, and realised portfolio standard deviation was 10%. What is the Sharpe ratio?

explanation.text: The Logic: Sharpe = (Rp - Rf) / sigma_p = (14% - 6%) / 10% = 8% / 10% = 0.80. Sharpe measures excess return per unit of TOTAL risk. The Trap: (A) 0.60 uses (Rp-Rf) = 6%. (B) 1.40 uses Rp alone over sigma. (D) 1.00 forgets to subtract Rf in the numerator. Note: Workbook pages 191-193 give the Sharpe formula and example, while page 62 provides the CML context. Use total standard deviation, not beta, in the denominator.
